newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha still tight, but price gain lags crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha still tight, but price gain lags crude.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices lagged the gains in crude, but the market remained tight, traders said. A trader continued to look for prompt pipeline-spec, upping the bid by $2.00 to $232.00 cif NWE, but still found no offer. Traders said a Bombay cargo which was passed to a U.K. utility last week was available, but no firm offer was reported. Algeria's Skikda port was loading over the weekend and on Monday after a week-long closure, but most delayed cargoes were due to sail for the U.S. anyway, and one dealer said the impact of the delays in Europe was limited. Increased buying by a major European utility was a more significant factor, he added.
